baseline.method: word-tokenized prose from chapters/01 and chapters/02 combined; markers and headings stripped; captured from these same two chapters after they were rewritten for voice consistency, so this baseline is a fit against itself, not an independent sample, and book-level drift against it measures 0.02; a single chapter measured against this book-level baseline is a smaller, different population, which structurally inflates type_token_ratio (chapter 1 alone measures 0.5057, chapter 2 alone 0.4934, versus 0.4171 combined here) and drives most of any one chapter's drift score; the metric correction and prose de-padding needed to remove this artifact are scheduled as tranche 2 work against roadmap row 1.7 (voice registers)
